name: JR PHEEF Interoperability Capability Manifest
summary: Describes active browser capabilities and a limited member-scoped inbound partner event API. This does not grant general device, account or outbound action access.

inbound.description: Devices, applications and organisations may eventually send authorised requests/events into JR PHEEF.
inbound.planned_auth: OAuth 2.1 / PKCE for user-delegated access; signed service credentials for approved partners
inbound.active_auth: Member-created, one-time displayed bearer token; SHA-256 hash at rest; events:write scope only; member revocation.

outbound.description: JR PHEEF may eventually coordinate permitted actions on connected devices and services.

browser_capabilities: Camera and microphone APIs with permission
integration_status: LIMITED INBOUND PARTNER EVENT GATEWAY ACTIVE; GENERAL PUBLIC API, OUTBOUND ACTIONS AND DEVICE CLOUD CONNECTIONS ARE NOT ACTIVE
